chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
How easy it is to make the people happy with you: restrain your tongues from them.
ai.seo_question: How can one easily gain the favor of people according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the virtue of *kaff al-lisan* (restraining the tongue) as the primary means to secure the goodwill of the general public (*al-nas*). This teaching aligns with the Shia concept of *al-mu'asarah bi-l-husn* (social conduct with excellence), emphasizing that avoiding gossip and backbiting is a practical path to maintaining social harmony and preventing unnecessary enmity.
